basic_details.job_title: NDFDC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 5 Chief Manager, Assistant Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The National Divyangjan Finance and Development Corporation (NDFDC), a wholly owned CPSE under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan), Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, is filling five posts, one each: Chief Manager (Finance), Asst. Manager (Finance), Sr. Executive, Sr. Executive (Accounts) and Jr. Executive. Applications are accepted by post only, addressed to the NDFDC office in New Delhi, and must reach on or before 31 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About NDFDC
content_sections.text: NDFDC was set up with the objective of providing financial assistance to Persons with Disability for self-employment. The notice describes it as a wholly owned CPSE, and its office is at DLF Prime Tower, Okhla Phase-I, New Delhi. It says the Corporation is looking for suitable result oriented persons to fill the posts.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent through post only. The notice asks candidates to write in capital letters on top of the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF" followed by the post name. The address is: National Divyangjan Finance and Development Corporation (Dept. of Empowerment of PwDs (Divyangjan), Ministry of SJ&E, Government of India), Unit No.11&12, Ground Floor, DLF Prime Tower, F-79-80, Okhla Phase-I, New Delhi - 110020. The application is typed neatly on plain paper in the format below, with a recent passport size photograph and the demand draft where the fee applies. It must be complete in all respects, strictly in the prescribed format, and reach on or before 31 December 2026. Post applied for. Name, and Father's/Husband's name. Date of birth and age as on 30-11-2026 (attach attested copy of birth certificate). Category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwDs/XSM/Gen.), with an attested copy of the certificate. Disability category and percentage of disability, with an attested copy of the disability certificate issued by the competent authority for a Person with Disability. Present address for communication, permanent home address, contact numbers and e-mail. Academic/professional qualification in reverse chronological order, starting from the highest: course, discipline, main subjects, university/institution with complete address, year of passing and percentage of marks/division (attach attested copies). Details of present and past employment: employer, posts held with pay scale, duration, whether revised or pre-revised IDA/CDA pattern, and nature of duties against each post (attach attested copies of certificates). Demand draft of Rs.500 (non refundable) in favour of National Divyangjan Finance and Development Corporation, with place, date and signature of the candidate.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The pay scales are Revised IDA pattern. Age limit, qualification and experience are counted as on 30-11-2026. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Ex-Serviceman/Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) (Divyangjan) and other categories is given as per Central Government rules; the notice prints no relaxation figures. Experience and age limit may be relaxed for otherwise exceptional candidates at the discretion of the Management. Essential qualification: Degree in Commerce/CA/ICWA/ MBA (Finance) from recognised institute/ university. Experience: Minimum 5 Years experience in relevant field at Executive level. Desirable: Preference will be given to candidates who have experience in the use of computer for the financial management, budgeting and maintaining accounts. Age limit: 42 Years. Essential qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant from ICAI/Qualified Company Secretary from ICSI/Qualified Cost Accountant from ICWAI/02 years MBA (Finance) from recognised University/Institute of repute. Experience: 01 year experience in Government/Banking/Financial Institution/Corporate Sector in relevant field. Age limit: 37 Years. Essential qualification: Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce from a recognised University. Experience: Minimum 3 years experience in the establishment and general administration. Knowledge of using computer. Desirable: Diploma/Certificate in Personnel Management/Industrial relation; knowledge of typing (Hindi/English). Age limit: 32 Years. Essential qualification: CA (Inter)/ICWA (Inter)/B. Com from recognised Institute/University. Experience: Minimum 2 Years experience in relevant field. Desirable: Knowledge of Tally accounting software. Age limit: 32 Years. Essential qualification: Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce. A certificate course in computer application of not less than six months duration from a reputed institution. Knowledge of standard software packages (MS-Office, Word, FOXPRO etc.). Data entry speed of not less than 6000 key depressions per hour. Age limit: 30 Years. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Annexure I - one recent passport size photo pasted on the application. Annexure II - attested copy of proof of age. Annexure III - attested copy of certificate of SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwDs, wherever applicable. Annexure IV - attested copy of Disability certificate, if applicable. Annexure V - attested copies of all academic/professional qualifications, in reverse chronological order. Annexure VI - attested copies of experience certificate(s).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice states that only short listed eligible candidates shall be called for written examination/skill test/interview. It does not describe the stages, marks or dates further. Outstation SC and ST candidates called for the interview/selection test are paid a single return second class rail fare or actual bus fare, whichever is less, in accordance with Government Directives.

Allowances admissible in addition to pay and IDA include HRA/Company leased accommodation to eligible executives, Medical Allowance, Newspaper allowance, Transport subsidy/Conveyance allowance, Leave, EPF, LTC and gratuity, as per the rules of the Corporation to regular employees only.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NDFDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies, one each for Chief Manager (Finance), Asst. Manager (Finance), Sr. Executive, Sr. Executive (Accounts) and Jr. Executive.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NDFDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach NDFDC on or before 31 December 2026. Applications received after the closing date are rejected outright.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply online for the NDFDC posts?
faq.answer: No. The notice says applications are to be sent through post only, in the prescribed format on plain paper, to the NDFDC office at DLF Prime Tower, Okhla Phase-I, New Delhi - 110020.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Jr. Executive post?
faq.answer: A degree in Arts/Science/Commerce, a computer application certificate course of at least six months, knowledge of standard software packages (MS-Office, Word, FOXPRO etc.) and a data entry speed of not less than 6000 key depressions per hour.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for each NDFDC post?
faq.answer: The limits are 42 years for Chief Manager (Finance), 37 years for Asst. Manager (Finance), 32 years for Sr. Executive and Sr. Executive (Accounts), and 30 years for Jr. Executive, as on 30-11-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for NDFDC posts?
faq.answer: Chief Manager (Finance) gets Rs.60,000 - 1,80,000, Asst. Manager (Finance) Rs.30,000 - 1,20,000, both Sr. Executive posts Rs.27,000 - 1,00,000 and Jr. Executive Rs.25,500 - 90,000, all on the IDA pattern.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee, and who is exempted?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.500 (non refundable) by demand draft in favour of National Divyangjan Finance and Development Corporation. SCs/STs/PwDs/Ex-Servicemen and departmental candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. Which posts are reserved for which category?
faq.answer: Chief Manager (Finance) and Sr. Executive (Accounts) are reserved for SC, Asst. Manager (Finance) for EWS, and Jr. Executive for Ex-Servicemen. Sr. Executive is Un-Reserved.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Only short listed eligible candidates will be called for written examination/skill test/interview. The notice gives no further detail on the stages.

faq.question: Q10. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The top of the envelope must carry, in capital letters, "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF" followed by the post name, addressed to National Divyangjan Finance and Development Corporation at the Okhla Phase-I address.
